user.title: Find a ski resort
user.description: Search OpenSkiMap for a resort by name. No API key needed — weather comes from the free Open-Meteo service.

data_description.query: Type part of the resort name, e.g. Vail, Whistler, Chamonix.

select.title: Choose the ski area
select.description: Pick the matching OpenSkiMap ski area. Its lift slug is filled in automatically when known.

error.no_results: No ski areas matched that name. Try fewer letters or clear the country filter.

abort.already_configured: This ski area is already configured.

init.title: Ski resort options
init.description: Weather is free via Open-Meteo. Optionally add live lift status (self-hosted Liftie or a RapidAPI key) and a RapidAPI snow-forecast.

data_description.liftie_base_url: e.g. http://homeassistant.local:3000 — if set, lift status comes from your Liftie instance (free).
data_description.rapidapi_key: Enables skiapi lift status and the RapidAPI snow-forecast. Leave blank to stay fully free.
data_description.forecast_resort: The snow-forecast resort name (needs a RapidAPI key), e.g. Vail or Beaver-Creek.
